chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 329: Yu Wei Awakens Past-Life Memories & Ji Ning's Question
chapter_meta_description: Yu Wei awakens her past-life Loose Immortal memories, turning the tide against Greenwood Vulture. Ji Ning hears her tragic past through a flute and asks a question about her past Dao-companion.
og_title: Yu Wei's Past-Life Awakening Shakes the Immortal Fortunes Assembly
og_description: Under desperate pressure, Yu Wei's past-life memories explode forth, turning her from a burden into a powerhouse. The aftermath brings a quiet, emotional flute melody.
twitter_title: Yu Wei awakens! A stunning reversal and a heartbreaking flute song.
twitter_description: Yu Wei’s past-life memories surge back, allowing her to fight off a top-tier foe. Later, a soulful flute melody reveals her tragic past to Ji Ning.

lore_anchors.definition: A cultivator who failed their tribulation in a past life and was reborn through the cycle of reincarnation; their past-life memories are normally sealed.
An extremely rare event where intense emotional or physical stress forces a reincarnated immortal’s sealed past-life memories to resurface.
The supreme Dao of the 'Supreme Ultimate,' the ontological principle of Yin-Yang duality and unity.
A set of seventy-two flying needles, a human-ranked treasure set used by Yu Wei.
An immortal who has transcended birth and death, achieving a state of pure, undecaying Yang energy.
A cultivator who failed their Celestial Tribulation but survived, facing periodic, increasingly dangerous lesser tribulations.
A pocket dimension treasure used for the trials of the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A classic divine ability that multiplies a cultivator's arms and attack frequency in battle.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Yu Wei's past-life memories awaken?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Extreme emotional stress from nearly sacrificing her place in the trial caused an explosive surge in her soul, forcing the sealed memories of her previous life as a Loose Immortal to resurface.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Yu Wei now more powerful than Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In terms of raw Dao comprehension, yes—she now understands the Grand Dao of Taiji plus four complete Daos. But Ji Ning's raw physical power and unique abilities still keep them in a similar tier.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of Ji Ning's question about a past Dao-companion?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia culture, a Dao-companion is a soul-binding commitment. Ji Ning is subtly asking if her heart belongs to someone from her past life, testing the waters of their own bond.
